correctness.rationale: Differentiating the exact Bernoulli KL yields a linear-in-e^z numerator with positive coefficients and exactly one sign change. Direct endpoint derivatives put the capacity root between b/2 and b. The internal-energy derivative equals a positive population shift times (1-H_b), where H_b is strictly increasing from zero to infinity on z>b/2. The two optima are strictly ordered through the stationarity equation; the unique b tanh(b/2)/2=1 crossing classifies inversion. Uniform local Taylor expansion and convergent roots yield the exact loss limit. Symbolic and numerical reproduction passed 3,000 assertions; finite checks are corroboration, not the proof.

originality.rationale: Qualified best-knowledge finding. Complete motivating paper including its appendices was inspected; it supplies exact stationary populations and KL capacity but studies time, SOC, power and efficiency at an externally specified gap. The present theorem supplies two independent global energy-gap maximizations, their strict order, a unique population-inversion threshold, and a nontrivial weak-driving loss constant. Comparison with closely related RC and discharging research, six published-record semantic queries and relevant published scientific claims found no statement implying the complete classification. The pointwise source formula permits differentiation, so implicit or unindexed priority is a real recorded risk; independent audit remains outstanding.
residual_risks: The primary paper already gives pointwise closed expressions in E and a; unindexed optimization work or a broader theorem might implicitly derive the new conclusions.
A 2026 finite-time discharging article was not inspected in full; its abstract suggests different scope but the comparison is limited.
Published semantic-record retrieval is incomplete and does not prove the claim has never been published.

value.rationale: Distinguishing recoverable relative-entropy work from excess mean energy is physically motivated by the source battery definition. Their optimal level spacings differ strictly, and population inversion at the energy-optimal design has a sharp affinity threshold absent for the work-optimal design. The weak-driving capacity penalty is about 42 percent, a concrete thermodynamic design consequence beyond parameter substitution or a tiny numerical improvement. It is a complete and nontrivial all-affinity classification for a natural independently tunable design knob, with explicit limitations regarding fixed affinity and operating costs.
